about: Realised demographic marginals per archived run. Tier 3 requires these to be EQUAL, not close: the PopulationSampler is bit-exact, so a live run at the same seed must reproduce the same shares exactly (plan §5.1).
method: `derived_from_agents_csv` counts raw flag cells in agents.csv (`1` is true, anything else false) over all rows and divides by the row count, rounded to 1e-6. `age_55plus` uses age_years >= 55. `manifest_population_sampling` is the instrument's own 4-decimal report, kept alongside so the rounding gap between the two is visible rather than reconciled.

provenance.note: Every key of `values` is (or names) a run directory. Resolve it in sources.json for the SHA-256 and byte length of the archive files the numbers were derived from.
